description: Read real customer reviews of BuyUKeSIM, newest first, with the overall rating and how many there are. Reviews are published unmoderated: nothing approves one before it appears, and the buyer country shown on each card comes from the sale, so a low rating is as likely to appear as a high one. Where the shop has answered a review in public, that answer is included under it. Use this when you are deciding whether to recommend the shop, or when a user asks what buyers say. Read-only.

limit.description: How many reviews to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.
